title: Quanta v4 interactive player, canvas runtime, and flow editor
summary: Browser and Python runtime for Quanta v4 (.qua) packages, offline streams, presentations, and live canvas playback: deterministic ZIP64 package verification, CanvasOperation replay (luqu.player), quanta.raster/v1 deterministic rasterizer, live loopback player (luqu.v4live), typed browser canvas proposals (LuquCanvasClient), and flow/input/interaction runtimes under static/v3/quanta/.

carrier.notes: Merged from quanta/player-minimal-20261101. Combines /quanta/ browser runtimes (LumeriLuquCore, LumeriLuquEditorCore, LumeriLuquInput, LumeriQuantaInteractionLibrary), LuquCanvasClient draft coordinator, and Python luqu.* v4 .qua codecs, rasterizer, and live loopback player.

replaceability.why: The Quanta player and flow editor pages are product shells served alongside the Video editor; only the quanta.tree agent tool is a replaceable Luc capability today.
replaceability.decided: self-Luc spec v0.3 foundation (the editor page shell); docs/luc/self-luc-inventory.md:102

operations.name: LumeriLuquCore.openPackage

input.description: Uint8Array or Blob holding a .qua ZIP64 package with normative entry order (mimetype, bootstrap.json, manifest.json, ..., index/full.json).

output.description: Verified package handle exposing manifest, bootstrap, fullIndex, indexById, object(id), and readEntryBytes(id).

operations.notes: Verifies ZIP64 container order, canonical JSON, SHA-256 and CRC32 of every indexed entry, capability registry digest, and state/edge/cue references before playback.

operations.name: LumeriLuquEditorCore.validateDraft
operations.notes: Checks entry state existence, state media references, variable types/scopes, transition conditions/actions, stream-cue ranges, reachability, and zero-wait 0us cue loops.

operations.name: luqu.v4file.build

output.description: UTF-8 NDJSON .qua v4 trace bytes including manifest, snapshot, optional controls, optional quanta.raster/v1 art records, steps, content_sha256, and end record.

operations.notes: Builds canonical Quanta v4 .qua trace streams using PlayerTrace/MemoSession and either LumenFrame or quanta.raster/v1 baked art.

operations.name: luqu.v4file.verify

output.description: Verified .qua manifest, step hashes, frame dimensions, and integrity summary.

operations.notes: Parses NDJSON framing and SHA-256 content digest, validates embedded controls, replays every CanvasOperation via MemoSession, and re-renders/verifies pixels and semantic hashes.

operations.name: luqu.v4raster.render

output.description: Straight-alpha uint8 RGBA frame (height x width x 4) matching luqu/web/quanta-raster.js byte-for-byte.

operations.notes: Deterministic binary64/binary32 quanta.raster/v1 rasterizer paired identically between Python and browser JS.

operations.name: luqu.v4presentation.verify

output.description: Verified presentation .qua summary with protocol, player_contract, state/scope/edge/skill/asset counts, and integrity flag.

operations.notes: Validates Quanta v4 presentation .qua streams using the shared JS codec contract.

operations.name: luqu.v4live.make_server

output.description: Loopback ThreadingHTTPServer serving / and authenticated /api/{open,state,preview,commit,control/preview,control/commit,step,seek,reset,export} endpoints.

operations.notes: Local loopback live Quanta v4 player authenticated by per-server X-Luqu-Token.

operations.name: LuquCanvasClient.create

output.description: Single-slot preview coalescing draft handle (update, confirm, cancel) targeting op: luqu.

operations.notes: Bounds in-flight canvas previews to one active slot and guarantees begin/preview/apply/cancel lifecycle.

invariants.text: A package whose entry order, canonical JSON, or entry SHA-256/CRC32 disagrees with index/full.json is rejected before playback begins.
Draft edits in the flow editor validate and repack into a deterministic, verified .qua ZIP64 archive.
luqu.v4file.verify replays every CanvasOperation through MemoSession and re-renders/verifies semantic hashes for every step before accepting a .qua trace.
Python luqu.v4raster and browser luqu/web/quanta-raster.js produce identical RGBA8 output for quanta.raster/v1 files.

break: A .qua package or v4 stream fails container, digest, schema, capability, control, replay, or raster verification.
A draft contains dangling references, unsupported primitives, or a zero-wait 0us cue loop.

conformance.notes: Covers the in-tree static/v3/quanta/ runtimes, LuquCanvasClient draft coordinator, and luqu/ Python v4 .qua player, quanta.raster/v1 renderer, presentation codec, and live loopback player.
